prompt: When $(2x - 3)(x + 5)$ is expanded and written in the form $ax^2 + bx + c$, what is the value of $b$?
hint: You only need the $x$ terms, not the whole expansion.

hints.text: You only need the $x$ terms, not the whole expansion.

hints.title: 🪜 Try a simpler one
hints.text: Try smaller binomials: $(x + 1)(x + 2) = x^2 + 3x + 2$, where the middle term $3x$ came from $2x + x$. Only the outer and inner products make an $x$ term.
The two products giving an $x$ term are $2x \cdot 5$ and $-3 \cdot x$.

learningObjective: Extract a single coefficient from a binomial product.
explanation: The question asks only for $b$, which is $7$.

alternativeExplanations.title: Target just the term you need
steps: The $x$ term comes only from the outer and inner products of FOIL.
Skipping the first and last products saves time and removes two chances to make a sign error.
